correctness.rationale: The expected inner state is an exact scalar affine recurrence on each eigendirection. Solving it and the exponential average gives \(\phi_K\); the exact Gaussian mean gives \(\phi_\infty\). In the nonoscillatory regime, \(S_K\) increases with its argument while \(S_K(z)/z\) decreases for \(K\ge2\), proving both strict condition-number inequalities. The embedded verifier replays the recurrence and endpoint inequalities.

value.rationale: Smoothing the landscape is a central mathematical motivation of Entropy-SGD, while the implemented algorithm uses only a short inner estimator. The theorem separates the ideal smoothing from what a finite inner budget represents: one step gives no conditioning benefit, finite loops give partial smoothing, and only resolved inner dynamics approach the ideal condition number.
